subject: Aboard the colony ship ariadne, in the bay where the work is being done. Lou wants Nolan's security detail taught to pack a wound and tie off a bleed: two shifts a month, off their rounds. "Somebody on your detail is going to put a tourniquet on the wrong end of a man one day, and I'd rather spend two shifts on it now than a night on it afterwards." Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.
